title: Synthetic In-store AI Visual Experience A/B
decisionQuestion: Should an eight-week Shanghai pilot use a browser-based AI visual vendor, an internal build, or a reduced manual-assisted alternative?

materials.label: synthetic-ab-brief.txt
materials.content: The pilot uses existing in-store screens and customer face photos. Device/browser versions, vendor data location, retention, traffic, quote, content-production capacity, onsite network, UAT owner, and rollback are unknown. Target window is eight weeks.
